import json,httpx
from hermes_local import backend
from hermes_local.backend import OllamaClient
base=b'{"model":"base","message":{"content":"answer"},"done":true,"done_reason":"stop"}'
cases=[
 ('duplicate_model',base.replace(b'"model":"base"',b'"model":"other","model":"base"'),False,None),
 ('duplicate_done',base.replace(b'"done":true',b'"done":false,"done":true'),False,None),
 ('invalid_utf8',base.replace(b'answer',b'bad\xffanswer'),True,None),
 ('nonfinite_metadata',base[:-1]+b',"unknown":NaN}',False,None),
 ('overflow_metadata',base[:-1]+b',"unknown":1e999}',False,None),
 ('ignored_oversize_metadata',base[:-1]+b',"padding":"'+b'x'*1000+b'"}',False,('MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES',128)),
 ('oversize_record',base+b' '*200,True,('MAX_STREAM_RECORD_BYTES',128)),
 ('blank_record_flood',b'\n'*6+base,True,('MAX_STREAM_RECORDS',4)),
 ('ordinary_nonstream',base,False,None),('ordinary_stream',base,True,None),
]
observed=[]
for name,raw,streaming,limit in cases:
 backend.MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES=16*1024*1024;backend.MAX_STREAM_RECORD_BYTES=8*1024*1024;backend.MAX_STREAM_RECORDS=16384
 if limit:setattr(backend,limit[0],limit[1])
 tokens=[]
 def handle(request): return httpx.Response(200,content=raw)
 row={'case':name,'streaming':streaming,'fixture_limit':limit,'wire_bytes':len(raw)}
 try:
  result=OllamaClient(transport=httpx.MockTransport(handle)).generate(model='base',prompt='fixture',on_token=tokens.append if streaming else None)
  row.update(accepted=True,content=result.content,finish_reason=result.finish_reason)
 except ValueError as exc:row.update(accepted=False,reason=str(exc))
 row['emitted']=tokens;observed.append(row)
print(json.dumps(observed,ensure_ascii=True,allow_nan=False))
